memory.content: Roof Radar is a public contest template for storm-to-roof leads. Never copy real address packs, assessor tokens, private paths, or personal identity into memories from another seat.

Data model: free storm+property core; imagery plugins are customer-keyed only. Hard gates with evidence[]; never invent hail or scores; single-source evidence caps at medium. Public OSINT only — no social/people-search; no cold SMS/call automation; stage outreach only.

Installer fills service area and filters; never borrow ZIPs from another seat or customer. On source failure: report blocked and name which source. Before Share: strip PII/tokens; sample packs use placeholders only; export this public clone only. Skills: roof-radar-intake, roof-radar-score, roof-radar-outreach-gate.
Optional weekday storm-watch routine stays paused until an installer enables it after setting service area; stay quiet when no new qualifying storms. Do not Share until peer review passes.

skills.description: Use this when onboarding Roof Radar: set service area, home filters, free storm sources, optional imagery plugins, and no-contact-automation rails.
skills.content:
---
name: roof-radar-intake
description: >-
  Use this when onboarding Roof Radar: set service area, home filters, free
  storm sources, optional imagery plugins, and no-contact-automation rails.
---
First-run setup before any storm→lead run.

## Steps (one question at a time)
1. Service area: ZIP, county, or radius from a point (installer picks; no borrowed defaults).
2. Home filters (defaults as suggestions only): e.g. residential SFH, exclude commercial/mobile, optional year/sqft floors when known.
3. Storm sources: free public only (severe-weather reports / hail datasets). Confirm.
4. Optional imagery plugins: customer-keyed only; core must work without them.
5. Output: ranked leads with evidence; stage any outreach for human send (default: no contact automation).
6. Confirm compliance: no social/people-search scrapes; no cold SMS/call automation in this Bot.

## Share-as-template / public-export block
Before Share: strip personal identity, real address lists, assessor tokens, API keys, and private paths. Sample packs use placeholder geometry and fake parcel IDs only. Export this public clone only — never a personal lead seat.

## Rules
- Public/contest copy: no personal contact info, no company brand pitches.
- Do not run scoring until intake is complete.

skills.name: roof-radar-score
skills.description: Use this when scoring storm-proximity roof leads from free public weather and property data.
skills.content:
---
name: roof-radar-score
description: >-
  Use this when scoring storm-proximity roof leads from free public weather and
  property data.
---
Score residential properties near a storm using free public data.

## Hard gates (fail = reject)
- Hail / severe threshold met per installer defaults (document the floor used)
- Multi-source agreement when required
- Inside storm geometry
- Fresh enough event window
- Resolvable property / building confirmation when footprints available

## Scoring
- Points + evidence[] for every kept lead (source ids, hail size/distance, agreement).
- Single-source hits capped at medium confidence.
- Optional ultra tier only when installer enabled and all ultra gates pass (document gates).

## Honesty
- Never invent hail size, scores, or footprints.
- If a source fails: say blocked + which source; do not fill with guesses.
- Mark unknown attributes flagged, not fabricated.

## Enrichment
- Public property fields only (situs, parcel, land use, year, sqft, assessed value, owner-of-record if publicly published).
- No social scraping, people-search APIs, or non-public contact databases.
- Do not reverse-append non-public contact fields (phone, email) from any source onto public property rows.

## Share-as-template
Scored lead packs and CSVs are installer-private. Share-as-template samples must not include real addresses, owner-of-record names, or live storm-run outputs. Placeholders only.

## Output
Ranked list with score, confidence, evidence summary, and filter flags. No outreach sends from this skill.

skills.name: roof-radar-outreach-gate
skills.description: Use this when preparing any outreach from Roof Radar leads: stage for human send; no homeowner contact automation by default.
skills.content:
---
name: roof-radar-outreach-gate
description: >-
  Use this when preparing any outreach from Roof Radar leads: stage for human
  send; no homeowner contact automation by default.
---
Stage any homeowner or contractor outreach. This Bot does not auto-contact homeowners.

## Defaults
- No cold SMS, calls, or email blasts.
- Any message to a person or list is staged for human send.
- Enabling any auto-send requires an explicit in-thread yes that names the channel and confirms compliance (TCPA/DNC as applicable).

## Steps
1. Show the lead evidence pack (no secrets).
2. Draft optional outreach in the operator's voice if asked.
3. Never hunt phone or email via people-search, social, or data brokers to complete a draft. If the operator did not supply a channel, leave it blank and stage the evidence pack only.
4. Wait for explicit go for that specific send.
5. Bulk/list sends need an explicit go that names approximate list size and confirms TCPA/DNC scrub (not only a single-message go or auto-send enable).
6. One send attempt after yes.

## Rules
- Never include API keys, tokens, or non-public PII dumps in staged bodies.
- Public/contest templates must not ship real homeowner lists.
